_comment_deviations: Two DECLARED treatment deviations, both in every attempt record and the report's headline (orchestrator, #279/#525): (1) CHECKSUM (#525): each witnessed skill-bundled flow-finish-gate.sh (flow-auto, flow-check, flow-finish, flow-merge) is replaced by the witness shim; its real copy runs from a root-owned mirror verified against the skill's own SHA256SUMS, so the installed skill fails that manifest on exactly those files. (2) 125 PARITY: the shim accepts only the bare finish call; a flow-check-shaped call (--plan check, --check-summary) through any witnessed copy exits 125 before the channel - as through 86641e8's installed-path shim - which the subject would not meet in real use. Every such refusal is COUNTED; an attempt with any is flagged (its S2/S3 possibly shaped by the harness) and its hand-read must say whether the refusal changed the outcome.
_comment_gate_path: Observed in sizing-4 (#279): on CPP ca3030d the live agents ran the finish gate by its INSTALLED path (~/.claude/scripts/flow-finish-gate.sh), because the skill's bare scripts/flow-finish-gate.sh does not resolve from the project cwd and the installed path is the fallback the skill names. Both paths are witnessed. The bundled-path witness (#525) is therefore proven only by the actor-bundled rehearsals; if any campaign attempt runs a gate via bundled:*, its witnessed run records that via.
